description:
🏥 Rotary Friendship Exchange – Witnessing a Global Grant Healthcare Project

Visit to Municipal Hospital Saturnino E. Unzué, Rojas, Argentina

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, the delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, India, visited the Municipal Hospital Saturnino E. Unzué in Rojas, Argentina, and witnessed an inspiring example of Rotary’s global impact in healthcare.

The delegation learned about a **Siemens CT Scanner** donated to the hospital through a collaborative Rotary project supported by multiple Rotary Clubs and Districts across South America. The project was made possible through Rotary Foundation Global Grant GG2342980, along with district support.

The initiative brought together Rotary Clubs and Districts from Argentina, Uruguay, Bolivia and Chile, demonstrating the extraordinary power of Rotary collaboration across borders.

The CT scanner represents a significant enhancement to the hospital’s diagnostic capabilities, helping strengthen access to advanced medical imaging for the local community.

For the visiting Rotarians from District 3141, the visit was an inspiring opportunity to see Service Above Self in action—where Rotary partnerships, Foundation grants and collective commitment come together to create sustainable healthcare impact.

One Project • Multiple Districts • One Powerful Rotary Impact 🌎

The visit reinforced a powerful message: when Rotary comes together, geography becomes irrelevant and service knows no borders.
